correctness.rationale: Balanced-centre induction proves distinctness of all rank-\(q\) coloured word types within length \(2^q-1\). The sharp finite-linear-order EF interval invariant constructs same-rank but opposite-parity unary words within each horizon. Finite classifier existence follows by Boolean closure of finitely many pairwise separators. The independently written checker tests 2883 game comparisons and the exact profile on specified finite ranges; computations are not used to infer the infinite statement.
